case.Y: A qualified service delivered inside the agreed response window
case.Omega: One region, one customer class, current qualification rules

largest_unknowns: Whether the alternative can pass customer qualification on schedule

nodes.label: Customer request
nodes.function: Defines the accepted output and response window

constraint_role.gate_mechanism: The request defines scope but does not itself withhold qualified provider passage
constraint_role.release_condition: A complete contract specification is issued
constraint_role.leverage_mechanism: One accepted specification coordinates all downstream service work
constraint_role.activation_dependency: The role matters when provider work must converge on one acceptance contract
constraint_role.observable: Specification changes alter qualification or accepted output across providers

nodes.label: Qualified provider
nodes.function: Converts available capacity into accepted service

constraint_role.gate_mechanism: Accepted service cannot pass while the incumbent is the only qualified operating path
constraint_role.release_condition: A substitute becomes qualified, available, and economical
constraint_role.leverage_mechanism: Additional accepted capacity releases multiple customer requests
constraint_role.activation_dependency: Demand reaches the capacity of the only qualified operating path
constraint_role.observable: Allocation, lead time, accepted volume, or terms change when qualified width changes

constraint_role.gate_mechanism: The alternative cannot carry accepted output until customer qualification is complete
constraint_role.release_condition: Customer approval plus available economical capacity
constraint_role.leverage_mechanism: A qualified second path can widen service capacity and bargaining options
constraint_role.activation_dependency: The incumbent remains capacity-constrained or commercially restrictive
constraint_role.observable: Orders, allocation, lead time, or terms move after qualification

edges.mechanism: The request becomes deliverable only through a qualified provider
edges.falsifier: The customer accepts an unqualified provider without delay or redesign

edges.mechanism: Qualification of the alternative increases effective width
edges.falsifier: The alternative qualifies but does not change allocation, lead time, or terms

claims.plain_claim: The customer currently has one accepted operating path, but a second path is being tested.
claims.technical_claim: Within the frozen boundary, N2 is the current minimum cut and N3 is a conditional substitute.
claims.falsifier: N3 qualifies and expands qualified output without rework

sources.title: Synthetic source used only to demonstrate the schema
sources.limitations: This is not real-world evidence and must not be used outside the example.

companies.name: Synthetic incumbent provider
companies.commercial_lever: Can negotiate allocation and service terms while it remains the only qualified operating path
companies.customer_counterpower: The customer controls qualification and is sponsoring N3
companies.falsifier: N3 qualifies and changes allocation or terms without material rework

hypotheses.boundary: The frozen region and customer class
hypotheses.mechanism: Qualification limits accepted service to N2 until N3 passes
hypotheses.expected_observable: Qualified output, allocation, lead time, or terms change after N3 enters
hypotheses.falsifier: N3 qualifies but does not increase an accepted and economical path
hypotheses.rights_shift: Acceptance remains with the customer while allocation power becomes less concentrated

snapshots.system_boundary: One region, one customer class, current qualification rules
snapshots.review_note: Initial synthetic snapshot before N3 qualification

predictions.expected_change: Successful qualification of N3 increases qualified effective width
predictions.observable: Orders, allocation, lead time, or contract terms move to N3
predictions.counterforce: N3 lacks economical capacity after qualification
predictions.invalidating_result: N3 qualifies but the system remains single-path for reasons outside the frozen boundary
